subject.title: [Feature]: Open bot-inclusive Slack group DMs from App Home

question: Should the bundled Slack plugin ship a native App Home flow that creates or resumes bot-inclusive MPIMs for selected users, or should OpenClaw keep only the documented private-channel/manual API workarounds?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Slack conversation-creation workflow, not a broken existing handler, and the issue already has protected maintainer/product-decision labels plus an open candidate PR.

options.title: Review linked implementation
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide the UX, authorization, and live-proof requirements on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102069 before closing it.

options.title: Reject core conversation creation
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide OpenClaw should not own Slack MPIM creation from App Home and should document private-channel or manual API alternatives instead.

options.title: Narrow to docs only
options.body: Use docs work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101944 to explain the limitation while leaving native MPIM creation out of scope.

recommendation.title: Review linked implementation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide the UX, authorization, and live-proof requirements on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102069 before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current Slack App Home surface and are the strongest history-backed owner for the boundary this issue would extend.
